ios.name: Tag Master
ios.subtitle: Learn barbershop tags
ios.description:
Find your next barbershop tag with the catalog from BarbershopTags.com. Search by title or lyrics, browse classic and recently added tags, and save favorites for your next afterglow.

View sheet music, listen to learning tracks, and watch performances when they are available. Adjust the left/right balance on stereo learning tracks to hear a part more clearly. Sound the starting pitch and share a tag with the people you sing with.

On a tablet, browse your list beside the selected tag. Use light or dark appearance on your phone or tablet.
ios.promotional_text: Browse barbershop tags, save favorites, and learn with sheet music and tracks.
